kind: predeclared implementation slice; not frozen taskbook, native evidence or implemented capability
scope: one bare rectangular A1 range lexeme only; source-borrowed result plus Workbook/explicit owner; no leading=, function parsing, full formula scan or writing
grammar: [leftSheet!]startAddress : endAddress; ASCII whitespace around token/colon may be retained; right qualifier always unsupported in initial slice
binding: No left qualifier: both endpoints bind owner. Explicit left qualifier: both endpoints inherit resolved left sheet. Preserve left explicitness and both dollar flags. Workbook lowercase lookup as existing binding; no new Excel Unicode equivalence claim.
shape: sameSheet and ascending row/column corners required; never silently reorder endpoints

negative.reason: right qualified unsupported even if it resolves to owner
right qualifier unsupported, no broadened fallback

must_verify: UTF8 spans and quoted apostrophe escaping retained without modifying source
right endpoint inherits left resolved SheetId; never binds owner independently after explicit left
unique colon outside quotes only; no split/global replace inside quoted names
function/string contexts must be recognized by future full grammar, not regex matched into ranges
unknown names/external/arrays/structuredrefs and right qualifiers refuse no partial result
grid, byte/catalog/count limits, trailing data and reversed corners refuse
compose with normalized range planner only after binding validation; Deleted not error serialization
